title: A detached child's successor root drops its acceptance bindings
outcome: Detach creates the successor root with the stranded child's acceptance bindings, so the successor still owes the bound host verification.
acceptance: A detach test shows the successor of a bound child keeps its exact binding, opens that binding's obligation on its own new run, and refuses completion until host verification of the bound kind passes.

detach_work passes the child's stored acceptance bindings to the successor's creation request. A child whose binding is pinned to an environment recorded on its own run, which the successor's new run cannot record, is refused before anything is written, with the `update --bind` that binds every criterion again without environments as its remedy, and the detach advisory behind DetachAvailable withholds detach in the same case; a test shows the refusal, its remedy, the withheld advisory, and a successful detach after the rebind. Nothing else about detach changes.

completion.summary: Landed in ae425e1, installed as build 9503287d8a34. detach_work gives the successor the child's stored acceptance bindings. A child whose binding is pinned to an environment of its own run is refused before anything is written, with the `update --bind` rebind as its remedy, and the DetachAvailable advisory withholds detach in the same case. The tests detach_keeps_a_bound_criterion_owed_by_the_successor and detach_refuses_a_criterion_pinned_to_the_environment_of_the_childs_run are both mutation-checked. Round 4 was clean from Codex and Claude, and gate test-e41f5f9a passed. Independent evaluation 7b88e825 passed both criteria.
